about_the_role: We build retrieval-augmented assistants over large private document collections. This role sits between research and engineering: you will design retrieval pipelines and measure whether they actually answer user questions correctly.
responsibilities: Design and evaluate Retrieval Augmented Generation pipelines over domain document collections.
Build and tune text chunking and embedding strategies for semantic search quality.
Maintain vector indexes and measure retrieval precision and recall against labelled query sets.
Integrate Large Language Models for grounded answer generation with citation of sources.
Profile and reduce latency and cost of inference workloads.
Partner with product to convert fuzzy requirements into measurable evaluation criteria.
required_skills: Advanced Python programming with clean, tested and well-structured code.
Deep understanding of Embeddings, vector similarity search and cosine distance.
Experience with vector databases such as FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone or Qdrant.
Practical experience with Large Language Models and prompt engineering.
Strong Machine Learning foundations and the ability to design honest evaluation methodology.
Experience building REST APIs, typically with FastAPI, to expose model functionality.
Proficiency with Git and collaborative software development practices.
preferred_skills: Experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex style orchestration frameworks.
Familiarity with PyTorch and fine-tuning transformer models.
Knowledge of NLP evaluation metrics and human annotation workflows.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud deployment on AWS or Google Cloud.
Exposure to monitoring and observability for machine learning services.
Understanding of data privacy considerations when handling customer documents.
qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent practical background.
Demonstrable projects involving semantic search, question answering or LLM applications.
